brand.headline: Your work, in columns that breathe.
brand.intro: Self-hosted, open-source Kanban boards. No ads and no third parties watching.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your instance to get back to your boards.
login.accountDeleted: Your account and your data have been deleted.
login.noAccount: Don't have an account? <link>Create one for free</link>
login.passwordReset: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
login.passwordSet: Password set. Sign in to start.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Free, for people and organizations. Already have an account? <link>Sign in</link>
register.honeypot: Do not fill in this field
register.acceptTerms: I have read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> and accept the <terms>terms of use</terms>.
register.firstLayer: Controller: {operator}. Purpose: providing your account and the service. Your data is not passed on to anyone. You can download or delete your data from the settings whenever you want.
register.closedBody: On this instance, accounts are created by whoever administers it. If you need one, ask that person.

personal.title: For me
personal.text: Your own boards, and share them with whoever you want.

organization.title: For my organization
organization.text: A company or team: you create your employees' accounts.

setup.title: Set up your instance
setup.subtitle: This wizard only appears once. Create your administrator account.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account's email and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If {email} has an account, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It expires in an hour. Look in the spam folder too.
forgot.unavailable: This instance cannot send email. Ask whoever administers it to reset your password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.hint: At least 8 characters. Every open session will be closed.
reset.invalid: This link is not valid any more: it expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
